name: OlmoBaseEval
intro: OlmoBaseEval 是 OLMo 3 为基础模型预训练与中训练决策构建的 43 任务评测套件。它以 2.3 万条外部模型结果、层次聚类、缩放相关性与信噪比实验筛选任务，形成 Base Easy 和 Base Main，并保留四项发布前未使用的独立留出基准。
build_method: 任务池构建, 排名层次聚类, 缩放与信噪比筛选
metric: 能力簇宏平均（BPB, Accuracy, F1, pass@k）
task_type: 基础模型综合评测, 问答, 数学, 代码
eval_feature: 预训练决策, 计算缩放, 能力簇聚合, 独立留出集
scale: 43项任务；Base Easy与Base Main；四项独立留出基准
build_method_en: Candidate Pool Construction, Ranking-based Hierarchical Clustering, Scaling and SNR Selection
eval_feature_en: Pretraining Decisions, Compute Scaling, Capability-cluster Aggregation, Independent Held-out Set
intro_en: OlmoBaseEval is the 43-task suite built by OLMo 3 for base-model pretraining and midtraining decisions. It selects tasks using 23K external-model results, hierarchical clustering, scaling correlation, and signal-to-noise experiments, yielding Base Easy and Base Main while reserving four independent benchmarks that were not used before release.
scale_en: 43 tasks; Base Easy and Base Main; four independent held-out benchmarks

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.13961's OlmoBaseEval methodology and the official allenai/olmes toolkit. The diagrams preserve the goal of low-noise, compute-efficient pretraining and midtraining decisions; broad candidate coverage; a 23K-result pool from 70 external open-weight models; Ward hierarchical clustering over model-ranking similarity; manual format alignment and the MC STEM/non-STEM split; scaling analysis with 25 OLMo 2 scaling models; Base Easy BPB proxies and Base Main headroom; signal-to-noise experiments with the final 50 OLMo 2 13B checkpoints, ten comparable external checkpoints, and repeated preliminary runs; full-set refinements; BasicSkills, Gen2MC, 17-language MBPP, and masked-perplexity additions; and the final 43-task Base Easy/Base Main suite. MMLU Pro, DeepMind Math, LBPP, and BigBench Hard remain an independent held-out set unused before release. Evaluation pins OLMES/vLLM task configurations and reports BPB, accuracy, F1, pass@k, and capability-cluster macro-averages.
